# Zugriff prüfen

> The console's page «Zugriff» (A-05, A-06) - «Was sieht …?» - where an administrator asks what a person, a role, the Knovas Assistent or an external agent reads, whether it may read one document, and what a search finds as it; and where the enforcement position is shown and one administrator switches it.

## Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `L2-PLATFORM-ACCESS-CHECK` |
| Kind | code |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |
| Level | 2 |
| Parent | `L1-WORKSPACE` |

### Source paths

- `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_access.py`
- `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_access.html`

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-ACCESS-CHECK/R-1` | «Was sieht …?» (PMVP-41): for a person, a role, the assistant (for a person) or an external agent, with the groups its claim would carry (RB-2, RB-6), the folder rules and own-rights documents it reads (computed, at most 25 rows, the rest a paged list), yes or no for one document with the reason, and a search as it, names only. Computed before «Ein»; once the client reports brokered, the yes or no and the search are the Core's own, asked as it. Reads per thing, writes nothing but one audit row by id. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_access.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_access.html` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ACCESS-CHECK/R-2` | The enforcement position (PMVP-42): one sentence for what the Core reports (rbac_posture, CR-R1a) - «Ein», «Aus», teilweise or unbekannt - and, while it reports not_ready codes, why «Ein» is not possible yet in the page's words; one administrator switches to the other position after a confirmation (set_rbac_posture brokered or disabled, CR-R8), the Core decides, its refusals in the page's words; disabled, «wartet auf Knovas», until the Core offers the switch. No approvals, no record of rights runs; audit rows by id. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/admin_access.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/admin_access.html` |

### Not responsible for

- The console's blueprint, its role gates and admin.css (L2-PLATFORM-ADMIN); the menu entry «Zugriff» (app.py, no card).
- The readers of the Core's groups, folder rules and documents and the reader closure (L2-PLATFORM-ROLE-DATA, imported).
- Who may read what; the Core decides, for the Platform's claims only under brokered (CR-R1, CR-R1a).
- Whether «Ein» is allowed - the Core's own preconditions (a broker key, the backfill, two green rights runs; CR-R7, CR-R8).

### Terms

- X (the person, role or agent a question is about; its groups are those its signed claim would carry)
